training: Train separate fresh LR and17-128-64-1 MLP for single-L100 and single-L300; same query IDs and same sampled candidate count per query for both L values; same labels and rows within each MLP/LR pair
constant_features: Zero first-layer/linear weights for columns constant in training. A single-L model cannot learn L dependence; this prevents arbitrary extrapolation of a constant L column when L300 is evaluated at L100. Applied identically to both training groups.
label: retain iff admitted_neighbors>0 OR in final baseline Top10 at its training L; same contribution proxy
epochs: max80, inner1000/200-query epoch selection then full1200-query refit; same initialization seed and architecture across L
static_threshold: Native scores on full validation baseline L100 cache-miss candidates, retain-FNR1% for each model
dynamic: Only trainL300 MLP/LR;8 presets from wide experiment, recalibrated at inferenceL100; select validation minimumP95 subject to Recall>=matching static trainL300 default; no retraining for dynamic policy
test: 8 groups,16 balanced cyclic repeats (8 positions x2); one shared DiskANN and one shared Heuristic pool; no historical timing reuse
limits: Both single-L model groups are freshly matched retrainings, not the historical L100 model weights
Previous wide model was mixed L30..1000, not pureL300; do not relabel it
Proxy FNR is not final Recall loss
